pilot_interpretation: Strict synchrony-to-reproduction evidence is feasible and already quantitatively extractable, but publication/program overlap and treatment-to-window identification remain major dependence/admission issues.

Pilot search has recovered substantial flowering-time/seasonal enemy-window evidence but no confirmed strict-H1 effect with independently measured partner activity plus final plant reproduction. This is a pilot evidence gap, not a systematic absence claim.

Nursery-pollination biology is rich, but strict synchrony-to-net-fitness evidence remains unresolved. Seasonal interaction-regime and mechanism evidence are much more common than direct synchrony effects.
